name: Goan Banana Filoz
instructions: 1. Peel the bananas and slice them into thick diagonal rounds or long strips.
2. In a mixing bowl, combine gram flour, rice flour, turmeric, red chili powder, asafoetida, and salt.
3. Gradually add water to create a thick, smooth batter that coats the back of a spoon.
4. Heat oil in a deep frying pan or kadhai over medium heat.
5. Dip each banana slice into the batter, ensuring it is well-coated.
6. Carefully drop the slices into the hot oil and fry in batches until they turn golden brown and crisp.
7. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Serve hot.
description: Goan Banana Filoz, often known as 'Banana Fritters', is a popular snack in Goan households. It perfectly balances the sweetness of ripe bananas with the savory, spiced crust, and is traditionally served alongside a hot cup of tea or coffee during the monsoon season.
